## Description

Please provide a brief summary of your changes and the problem they solve.

---

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement / Refactoring

---

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the coding style and architecture of this project.
- [ ] I have verified strict concurrency checks pass without warnings (`StrictConcurrency = YES`).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All existing and new tests pass locally (`swift test`).
- [ ] If applicable, I have attached screenshots or recordings demonstrating UI changes.
